821.was: The user strikes the  target with a flowing  motion three times in  a row. This move always  lands a critical hit.
821.text: The user strikes the foe three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.

822.name: Thunder Cage
822.was: The user traps the  target inside a cage of  sparking electricity  that inflicts damage  for four to five turns.
822.text: The foe is trapped in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns of damage.

825.name: Fiery Wrath
825.was: The user transforms its  wrath into a fire-like  aura to attack. This may  also make opposing  Pokémon flinch.
825.text: The user turns its wrath into a fire-like aura. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

826.name: Thunderous Kick
826.was: With lightning-like  movement, the user  delivers a kick. This  also lowers the  target’s Defense stat.
826.text: The user kicks with lightning-like movement. This also lowers the foe’s Defense stat.

829.name: Eerie Spell
829.was: The user attacks with  its tremendous psychic  power. This also drains  3 PP from the move last  used by the target.
829.text: The user attacks with psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the foe’s last move.

833.name: Stone Axe
833.was: The user swings its  stone axes at the  target. Splinters left  behind by this attack  float around the target.
833.text: The user swings its stone axes. Splinters left behind float around the foe.

839.name: Mountain Gale
839.was: The user hurls giant  chunks of ice at the  target to inflict  damage. This may also  make the target flinch.
839.text: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the foe. This may also make the foe flinch.

840.name: Victory Dance
840.was: The user performs an  intense dance to usher  in victory, boosting  its Attack, Defense,  and Speed stats.
840.text: The user dances to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense and Speed stats.

841.name: Headlong Rush
841.was: The user smashes into  the target in a  full-body tackle. This  also lowers the user’s  Defense and Sp. Def.
841.text: A full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

842.name: Barb Barrage
842.was: The user launches barbs  which may poison the  target. Its power is  doubled if the target  is already poisoned.
842.text: Barbs that may poison the foe. Power is doubled if the foe is already poisoned.

843.name: Esper Wing
843.was: The user slashes with  aura-enriched wings and  boosts its Speed. This  move has a heightened  critical hit chance.
843.text: The user slashes with aura-enriched wings and boosts its Speed. Critical hits come easily.

846.name: Triple Arrows
846.was: The user kicks and fires  three arrows. This has a  high critical hit chance  and may lower Defense or  make the target flinch.
846.text: A kick and three arrows. Critical hits come easily, and the foe may flinch or lose Defense.

847.name: Infernal Parade
847.was: The user summons myriad  fireballs which may burn  the target. Its power is  doubled if the target  has a status condition.
847.text: Fireballs that may burn the foe. Power is doubled if the foe has a status condition.

851.name: SandsearStorm
851.was: The user wraps opposing  Pokémon in fierce winds  and searingly hot sand.  This may also leave them  with a burn.
851.text: Fierce winds and searing sand wrap opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.

852.name: Lunar Blessing
852.was: The user receives a  blessing from the moon,  restoring HP and curing  status conditions for  itself and its allies.
852.text: A blessing from the moon restores HP and cures status for the user and its allies.

854.name: Tera Blast
854.was: If Terastallized, the  user unleashes energy of  its Tera Type. It can  use Attack or Sp. Atk-  whichever is higher.
854.text: If Terastallized, the user attacks with its Tera Type, using Attack or Sp. Atk, whichever is higher.

855.name: Silk Trap
855.was: The user spins a silken  trap, protecting itself  while lowering the Speed  of any attacker that  makes direct contact.
855.text: A silken trap protects the user and lowers the Speed of any attacker that makes contact.

856.name: Axe Kick
856.was: The user slams its heel  down upon the target,  which may also confuse  them. If it misses, the  user is hurt instead.
856.text: The user slams its heel down, which may also confuse the foe. A miss hurts the user.

857.name: Last Respects
857.was: The user attacks to  avenge its allies. The  more defeated allies  in the user’s party,  the greater its power.
857.text: The user avenges its allies. The more of them defeated, the greater this move’s power.

858.name: Lumina Crash
858.was: The user unleashes a  peculiar light that even  affects the mind. This  also harshly lowers the  target’s Sp. Def stat.
858.text: A peculiar light that affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

859.name: Order Up
859.was: The user attacks with  elegant poise. If it has  a Tatsugiri in its  mouth, this move boosts  one of the user’s stats.
859.text: The user attacks with poise. With a Tatsugiri in its mouth, one of its stats is boosted.

861.name: Spicy Extract
861.was: The user’s incredibly  spicy extract sharply  boosts the target’s  Attack stat and harshly  lowers their Defense.
861.text: A spicy extract sharply boosts the foe’s Attack and harshly lowers the foe’s Defense.

862.name: Spin Out
862.was: The user spins furiously  by straining its legs,  inflicting damage while  harshly lowering the  user’s Speed stat.
862.text: The user strains its legs to spin furiously, harshly lowering the user’s Speed stat.

863.name: Population Bomb
863.was: The user’s fellows  gather in droves to  perform a combo attack  that hits the target one  to ten times in a row.
863.text: The user’s fellows gather in droves to hit the foe one to ten times in a row.

865.name: Glaive Rush
865.was: The user charges  recklessly. Attacks on  the user on the next  turn always hit and will  inflict double damage.
865.text: The user charges recklessly. Attacks on it next turn always hit and deal double damage.

866.name: RevivalBlessing
866.was: The user’s loving  blessing revives a party  Pokémon that has fainted  and restores half that  Pokémon’s max HP.
866.text: A loving blessing revives a fainted party Pokémon and restores half its max HP.

867.name: Salt Cure
867.was: The user salt cures the  target, dealing damage  every turn. Steel and  Water types are strongly  affected by this move.
867.text: The foe is salt cured, taking damage every turn. Steel and Water types suffer more.

868.name: Triple Dive
868.was: The user performs a  perfectly timed triple  dive, hitting the target  with splashes of water  three times in a row.
868.text: The user hits the foe with splashes of water three times in a row.

869.name: Mortal Spin
869.was: A spin attack that can  eliminate such moves as  Bind, Wrap and Leech  Seed. It also poisons  opposing Pokémon.
869.text: A spin attack that eliminates moves like Bind, Wrap and Leech Seed. It also poisons foes.

870.name: Doodle
870.was: The target’s essence is  captured in a sketch.  This makes the Abilities  of the user and its ally  match the target’s.
870.text: The foe’s essence is sketched, making the Abilities of the user and its ally match the foe’s.

872.name: Kowtow Cleave
872.was: The user slashes at the  target after kowtowing  to make the target let  down its guard. This  attack never misses.
872.text: The user kowtows, then slashes the off-guard foe. This attack never misses.

873.name: Flower Trick
873.was: The user throws a rigged  bouquet of flowers at  the target. This attack  never misses and always  lands a critical hit.
873.text: The user throws a rigged bouquet. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

874.name: Torch Song
874.was: The user blows out  raging flames as if  singing, scorching the  target. This also boosts  the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
874.text: The user scorches the foe with raging flames. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

875.name: Aqua Step
875.was: The user toys with the  target and attacks using  light and fluid dance  steps. This also boosts  the user’s Speed stat.
875.text: The user attacks with light, fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

876.name: Raging Bull
876.was: The user performs a  tackle like a raging  bull. It can also break  barriers, such as Light  Screen and Reflect.
876.text: A tackle like a raging bull. It can also break Light Screen and Reflect.

877.name: Make It Rain
877.was: The user throws out a  mass of coins. This also  lowers the user’s Sp.  Atk stat. Money is  earned after the battle.
877.text: The user throws out a mass of coins. This lowers the user’s Sp. Atk. Money is earned after battle.

878.name: Psyblade
878.was: The user rends with an  ethereal blade. Its  power is boosted by 50  percent if the user is  on Electric Terrain.
878.text: The user rends with an ethereal blade. Power rises 50 percent on Electric Terrain.

879.name: Hydro Steam
879.was: The user blasts out  boiling-hot water. Its  power is not lowered in  harsh sunlight but  rather boosted by 50%.
879.text: The user blasts boiling water. Harsh sunlight boosts its power by 50% instead of lowering it.

881.name: ColisionCourse
881.was: The user causes a  massive prehistoric  explosion. This move’s  power is boosted more if  it’s super effective.
881.text: A massive prehistoric explosion. Its power is boosted more if it’s super effective.

882.name: Electro Drift
882.was: The user pierces its  target with futuristic  electricity. This move’s  power is boosted more if  it’s supereffective.
882.text: Futuristic electricity pierces the foe. Its power is boosted more if it’s super effective.

884.name: ChillyReception
884.was: The user tells a  chillingly bad joke  before switching out.  This summons a snowstorm  lasting five turns.
884.text: The user tells a bad joke and switches out. This summons a snowstorm for five turns.

885.name: Tidy Up
885.was: The user tidies up and  removes entry hazards  and Substitutes. This  also boosts the user’s  Attack and Speed stats.
885.text: The user removes entry hazards and Substitutes. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed.

890.name: Hyper Drill
890.was: The user spins at high  speed to pierce the  target. This attack can  hit through a move such  as Protect or Detect.
890.text: The user spins fast to pierce the foe. This hits through Protect or Detect.

892.name: Rage Fist
892.was: The user converts its  rage into energy to  attack. The more the  user has been attacked,  the greater the power.
892.text: The user turns rage into energy. The more it has been attacked, the greater the power.

893.name: Armor Cannon
893.was: The user shoots its own  armor out as blazing  projectiles. It also  cuts the user’s Defense  and Sp. Def stats.
893.text: The user fires its own armor as blazing projectiles. This cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

894.name: Bitter Blade
894.was: The user focuses its  bitter feelings into a  slash. The user’s HP  is restored by up to  half the damage taken.
894.text: The user’s HP is restored by up to half the damage it deals to the foe.

896.name: Gigaton Hammer
896.was: The user swings its  whole body around to  attack with its huge  hammer. This move can’t  be used twice in a row.
896.text: The user swings its huge hammer. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

904.name: Blood Moon
904.was: The user unleashes the  full brunt of its spirit  from a full moon.  This move can’t be used  twice in a row.
904.text: The user unleashes its spirit from a full moon. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

906.name: Syrup Bomb
906.was: The user sets off a  gooey explosion, which  causes the target’s  Speed stat to drop each  turn for three turns.
906.text: A gooey explosion drops the foe’s Speed stat each turn for three turns.

907.name: Ivy Cudgel
907.was: The user strikes with a  cudgel. It has a high  critical hit chance, and  its type changes with  the user’s mask.
907.text: The user strikes with a cudgel. Critical hits come easily, and its type changes with the user’s mask.

909.name: Tera Starstorm
909.was: The user bombards the  target with crystalline  power. When used by  Stellar Terapagos, this  move damages all foes.
909.text: Crystalline power bombards the foe. Used by Stellar Terapagos, it damages all foes.

910.name: Fickle Beam
910.was: The user shoots a beam  of light. Sometimes  the user’s heads shoot  in unison, doubling  the move’s power.
910.text: The user shoots a beam of light. Sometimes all its heads shoot at once, doubling the power.

911.name: Burning Bulwark
911.was: The user’s intensely hot  fur protects it from  attacks and also burns  any attacker that makes  direct contact with it.
911.text: The user’s hot fur protects it from attacks and burns any attacker that makes contact.

912.name: Thunderclap
912.was: The user attacks first  with a jolt of  electricity. This move  fails if the target is  not readying an attack.
912.text: The user attacks first with a jolt. This fails if the foe is not readying an attack.

913.name: Mighty Cleave
913.was: Light from atop the  user’s head cleaves the  target. This move hits  even if the target  protects itself.
913.text: Light from the user’s head cleaves the foe. This hits even if the foe protects itself.

916.name: Dragon Cheer
916.was: Allies’ morale is raised  with a draconic cry,  boosting their critical  hit rate. This rouses  Dragon types more.
916.text: A draconic cry boosts allies’ critical hit rate. Dragon types are roused more.

917.name: Alluring Voice
917.was: The user attacks using  its angelic voice. This  also confuses the target  if its stats have been  boosted during the turn.
917.text: The user attacks with its angelic voice. This confuses the foe if its stats rose this turn.

919.name: Supercell Slam
919.was: The user electrifies its  body and drops onto the  target. If this move  misses, the user takes  damage instead.
919.text: The user electrifies its body and drops on the foe. A miss hurts the user instead.

920.name: Psychic Noise
920.was: The user attacks with  unpleasant sound waves.  For two turns, the  target is prevented  from recovering HP.
920.text: Unpleasant sound waves prevent the foe from recovering HP for two turns.

921.name: Upper Hand
921.was: The user strikes  reactively, making the  target flinch. This move  fails if the target is  not readying a priority move.
921.text: The user strikes first and makes the foe flinch. This fails unless the foe readies a priority move.

922.name: Malignant Chain
922.was: The user pours toxins  into the target through  a corrosive chain. This  may also leave the  target badly poisoned.
922.text: Toxins pour into the foe through a corrosive chain. This may badly poison the foe.
